comment: Pricing feels steep compared to competitors for the same features.
Support took three days to respond to a billing question.
Love the new dashboard, much faster than the old one.
Found a bug where exports fail silently over 10k rows.
Wish there was a dark mode, staring at white all day is rough.
The onboarding flow was confusing, took a while to find settings.
Great product overall but the mobile app crashes on launch sometimes.
Would pay more for a proper audit log feature.
